normalized.title: 23/10695 - Integrated Geomodel for the Danish Offshore Wind 2030
normalized.description: Following a decision in the Danish Parliament in 2022 Denmark is on the path to further develop offshore energy and related infrastructure in the Danish North Sea, in the Danish inner seas (Kattegat) and Danish Baltic Sea to connect more offshore wind energy. The current tender concern three integrated 3D Geomodels, two in the Danish inner seas (Kattegat) and one in the Danish Baltic Sea. The Scope of Services is to deliver Integrated 3D Geomodels based on • Existing ground models from geophysical survey. • Preliminary geotechnical investigations. The Integrated Geomodels must cover the areas of investigation described below: • Lot 1: Kattegat II (123 km2) and Hesselø South (166 km2) • Lot 2: Kriegers Flak II North and South (175 km2) The Scope of Services will include the following elements: • Conceptual geological model. • Spatial geological model. (Kingdom workspace and related deliverables) • Geotechnical zones • Geotechnical characterization of soil units. The full suite of tender documents, including tender conditions, scope of services and contract draft will be issued to the prequalified applicants upon prequalification.
